newsitem.title: USA: General Mills sees FY97 capital spending rise.
newsitem.headline: General Mills sees FY97 capital spending rise.

text.p: General Mills Inc said it expects its capital spending for fiscal 1997, ending in May, will total $160.0 million, compared with $129.0 million spent in fiscal 1996.
In a recent Securities and Exchange Commission filing, General Mills said capital spending for the first nine months of fiscal 1997 totaled $113.7 million.
A General Mills spokeswoman said the figures for fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1996 exclude any development spending for joint ventures.
General Mills is the second largest ready-to-eat breakfast cereal company in the United States.
